description: This file defines an abstract base class for Akka actor-based message consumers within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates common functionality such as resource status handling, message forwarding, acknowledgements, and error handling for connectivity messaging components.

classes.name: BaseConsumerActor
classes.description: An abstract Akka actor class that provides common messaging and resource management functionalities for consumer actors in the Eclipse Ditto connectivity framework.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Abstract method that should return the logging adapter for derived classes.

methods.name: forwardToMappingActor
methods.description: Forwards an external message to the mapping processor actor and handles acknowledgements, errors, and retries.

methods.name: forwardToMappingActor
methods.description: Overloaded method to send an error message to the mapping processor for publishing in reply-target.

methods.name: resetResourceStatus
methods.description: Resets the current resource status to a new 'started' status with timestamp.

methods.name: getCurrentSourceStatus
methods.description: Returns the current resource status of the source.

methods.name: handleAddressStatus
methods.description: Updates the internal resource status based on the received resource status.

methods.name: forwardAndAwaitAck
methods.description: Sends a message to the response collector actor and waits asynchronously for acknowledgement responses.

methods.name: addSourceAndReplyTarget
methods.description: Augments a message with source and reply target headers.

methods.name: enrichHeadersWithReplyInformation
methods.description: Adds reply-target related headers to existing DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a unique identifier for the current instance.

methods.name: someFailedResponseRequiresRedelivery
methods.description: Determines if a collection of failed command responses require message redelivery.

methods.name: extractAggregatedResponses
methods.description: Extracts individual command responses from aggregated acknowledgement responses.

methods.name: requiresRedelivery
methods.description: Determines if a given status code signals the need for message redelivery.
